shared_elements: head with headdress or elaborate hairstyle
curvilinear low-relief motifs on a stone surface
circle/disc-like motifs (bowls in A, ring motifs in B)
justification: Both surfaces depict human figures with distinctive headgear/hair rendered in low relief, and both include roundish disc-like forms (offering bowls in A, ring motifs on the body in B), but these are generic correspondences. A is a horizontal procession of profile figures presenting vessels toward a larger frontal-headed dignitary, with careful naturalistic detailing of beards, garments and hands, whereas B is a single massive frontal figure with schematic, abstract curvilinear and ring motifs and no scene, interaction or narrative at all.
